goal: Admin map access control in backend routers and frontend/src/app/admin/dai-noi/annotate/
summary: Implemented comprehensive server-side RBAC, editor ownership, row_version optimistic concurrency control, CSRF / Bearer protection, and audit trail logging for administrative aerial map annotations. Negative abuse protection guarantees that non-privileged users (learners, guests) receive HTTP 403 Forbidden on all raw admin map endpoints, and unauthenticated callers receive HTTP 401 Unauthorized. Editor ownership enforces that non-admin editors can only mutate or archive their own annotations, while administrators retain override capabilities. Implemented defense-in-depth CSRF verification for cookie-authenticated requests with Bearer token exemption, validated If-Match concurrency headers, and updated frontend studio layout RBAC to recognize teacher roles.

invariants_enforced.server_side_rbac: All administrative map endpoints (/api/v1/imperial/admin/maps, /annotations, /audit) enforce STAFF_ROLES (teacher, admin, super_admin); map publication (/publish) is strictly restricted to ADMIN_ROLES. Learners and guests receive HTTP 403 Forbidden; unauthenticated callers receive HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
invariants_enforced.editor_ownership: Mutating endpoints (PATCH /admin/annotations/{id}, DELETE /admin/annotations/{id}) enforce that non-admin editors (teachers) can only modify or archive annotations where anno.created_by == actor_id. Cross-editor mutations return HTTP 403 Forbidden (IMPERIAL_ANNOTATION_FORBIDDEN). Admins have universal override authority.
invariants_enforced.row_version_optimistic_concurrency: Annotations track an integer row_version that increments on every update. Stale updates and mismatched If-Match headers (e.g. 'row-version-X') return HTTP 409 Conflict (IMPERIAL_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT) with current and submitted row versions in details.
invariants_enforced.csrf_and_bearer_protection: Mutating operations (POST, PATCH, DELETE) authenticated via ambient session cookies require an anti-CSRF custom header (X-Requested-With or X-CSRF-Token) and strictly reject Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site requests with HTTP 403 Forbidden. Direct API calls with Authorization: Bearer <token> are exempt from cookie CSRF checks.
invariants_enforced.tamper_evident_audit_trail: Every creation, modification, and archive/soft-deletion operation records an immutable entry in imperial_annotation_audits with actor attribution, action ('create', 'update', 'archive'), timestamps, and before/after state diffs.

changes.description: Added editor ownership enforcement (anno.created_by == actor_id or is_admin) to update_annotation and delete_annotation; added If-Match header version validation alongside payload.row_version check in update_annotation.
Added verify_map_admin_csrf to enforce CSRF / Bearer defense on mutating administrative endpoints; wired is_admin permissions and If-Match header checks into update_annotation and delete_annotation.
Imported text from sqlalchemy to support SQL text defaults in AssetCacheRevocation and HistoricalAsset.
Updated isStaffOrAdmin role guard to include 'teacher' role alongside admin and staff, providing seamless access for authenticated pedagogical staff.
Aligned test seed annotation author to staff user fixture to ensure consistent editor ownership in baseline test suite.

Created comprehensive 7-test suite verifying RBAC denial for learners/guests (403), unauthenticated rejection (401), teacher publication restriction (403), cross-editor mutation denial (403), admin override, row_version optimistic concurrency (409), If-Match validation, CSRF/Bearer token defense, and audit trail integrity.

test_details.name: test_unauthenticated_requests_receive_401
test_details.assertion: Verifies that anonymous requests to all administrative map and annotation endpoints return HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_learner_and_guest_receive_403
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse: Users with learner or guest roles are strictly forbidden (HTTP 403) from accessing admin map APIs.

test_details.name: test_teacher_role_boundary_cannot_publish_map
test_details.assertion: Verifies that teachers have staff curation access but receive HTTP 403 Forbidden when attempting map publication.

test_details.name: test_editor_ownership_lifecycle_and_cross_editor_denial
test_details.assertion: Verifies that an editor can update and delete their own annotations, another teacher receives HTTP 403 on cross-editor mutations, and administrators can override.

test_details.name: test_optimistic_concurrency_and_if_match_validation
test_details.assertion: Verifies that out-of-date row_version updates and mismatched If-Match headers are rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict.

test_details.name: test_csrf_cookie_protection_and_bearer_exemption
test_details.assertion: Verifies that cookie-authenticated mutations without custom anti-CSRF headers or with cross-site origins are rejected (HTTP 403), while requests with X-Requested-With or Bearer tokens succeed.

test_details.name: test_annotation_audit_logging_integrity
test_details.assertion: Verifies append-only audit logging across create, update, and archive lifecycle steps with accurate before/after state diffs.
